facts.business: Dhatre Udyog Limited (formerly Narayani Steels Limited) has shut down its manufacturing operations due to ageing plant and machinery and is exploring real estate development at its land in Jamshedpur.

auditor.name: M/s. P D Rungta & Co. Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to balances under Trade receivables, Advances at Debit/Credit and Trade Payables being subject to confirmations and adjustments; Material uncertainty related to going concern due to shutdown of manufacturing operations and disposal of plant & machinery.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to shutdown of manufacturing operations
Weak internal financial controls indicated by non-availability of account confirmations for trade receivables and payables
Company is exploring real estate development but no concrete plans disclosed
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions are at arms' length and in compliance with transfer pricing regulations. No materially significant related party transactions during the year ended 31 March 2026. Policy available on company website.
